---
title: "Florida's Invasive Snakes"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

species_columns <- c(
  "Brahminy blindsnake" = "Brahminy Blindsnake",
  "Burmese python" = "Burmese Python",
  "Boa constrictor" = "Boa Constrictor"
)

county_counts <- read_csv(
  "data/florida-invasive-snakes-by-county.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID))
county_map <- st_read("data/florida-counties.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) |>
  left_join(county_counts, by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(
    across(all_of(unname(species_columns)), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)),
    richness = rowSums(across(all_of(unname(species_columns)), ~ .x > 0)),
    popup_text = paste0(
      "<strong>", NAME, " County</strong><br>",
      "Species recorded: ", richness, " of 3<br>",
      names(species_columns)[[1]], ": ",
      format(.data[[species_columns[[1]]]], big.mark = ","), "<br>",
      names(species_columns)[[2]], ": ",
      format(.data[[species_columns[[2]]]], big.mark = ","), "<br>",
      names(species_columns)[[3]], ": ",
      format(.data[[species_columns[[3]]]], big.mark = ",")
    )
  )

species_totals <- county_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(across(all_of(unname(species_columns)), sum))

richness_colors <- c("#f2eee5", "#c5d8c6", "#75a895", "#26715f")
```

## Invasive snake observations by county

This map combines public observations of three non-native snakes. County shading shows how many of the selected species have been recorded in each area; select a county to see each species' record count.

> **Records are not a population census.** Sightings are unevenly reported, and a snake may be reported more than once. A county with more records does not necessarily have more snakes.

```{r}
#| label: map
#| echo: false
#| message: false

leaflet(county_map, width = "100%", height = 620) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~richness_colors[richness + 1],
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    label = ~paste(NAME),
    popup = ~popup_text,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#273b34",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = richness_colors,
    labels = c("No records", "1 species", "2 species", "3 species"),
    title = "Species recorded",
    opacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  fitBounds(lng1 = -87.7, lat1 = 24.3, lng2 = -80.0, lat2 = 31.1)
```

### Recorded observations

```{r}
#| label: totals
#| echo: false

tibble(
  Species = names(species_columns),
  `Recorded observations` = unlist(
    species_totals[1, unname(species_columns)],
    use.names = FALSE
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

The map uses a November 6, 2026 snapshot of public, non-captive iNaturalist observations for [Brahminy blindsnakes](https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/observations?place_id=21&taxon_id=539844), [Burmese pythons](https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/observations?place_id=21&taxon_id=238252), and [Boa constrictors](https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/observations?place_id=21&taxon_id=32093). Records with no public map location are excluded. Points were counted within county boundaries from the U.S. Census TIGERweb county map; private locations are not shown.
